subject: science
concept: Comparing different types of ecosystems (forest, ocean, desert) and their unique features
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Ecosystems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts organism and feature cards into their correct ecosystem type
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an ecosystem picture to organisms that would realistically live there
exercise.abstract: Student describes one unique feature of a given ecosystem type

misconception_flags: places an organism in an ecosystem it couldn't actually survive in

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
